Sundrug Co., Ltd.
is
a major Japanese drugstore and dispensing pharmacy chain rather than a specialized manufacturer of medical wearables or remote patient monitoring systems
. While Sundrug retail stores and their
Sundrug Online Store
sell general health supplies, nursing care goods, and basic home medical equipment, they do not produce or provide clinical continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), advanced wearable ECGs, or remote patient monitoring infrastructure.
Health and Monitoring Options
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Professional medical systems like Abbott FreeStyle Libre are typically distributed via specialized medical channels or clinical prescriptions in Japan rather than standard retail drugstore inventories.
Smartwatches and Wearables:
Consumer wellness trackers featuring optical heart rate or basic step and sleep tracking are widely available through electronics retailers and online marketplaces rather than Sundrug's core pharmacy catalog. Non-invasive blood sugar smartwatches sold online are consumer gadgets and lack clinical medical-grade accuracy.
